summary: Iran war is the dominant geopolitical risk — disrupting energy markets, shipping, and raising global inflation. IMF projects 3.1% global growth and 4.4% headline inflation in 2026 base case. Despite conflict, US/Japan/South Korea markets at all-time highs. US also intervening in Venezuela. Strait of Hormuz threat is key tail risk.
